caseName: Board of Public Education & Orphanage v. Lucas
caseNameFull: Board of Public Education and Orphanage for Bibb County v. Lucas

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Court of Appeals for clarification of the jurisdictional issue presented by the Solicitor General in his brief for the United States as amicus curiae filed June 4, 1991.
